restaurantName: Hock Hai (Hong Lim) Curry Chicken Noodle
address: Bedok Interchange Hawker Centre, #01-58, 208 New Upper Changi Road, 460208, Singapore
bio: The curry broth may be only mildly hot, but its flavours are deep. The chicken is tender; potato and tofu puffs soak up the sauces. Besides curry, there is satay chicken served on your choice from three varieties of noodles....
